dedupe_keys.name: evolution du trait de cote histogrammes guadeloupe

description: Evolution du trait de côte (histogrammes) Guadeloupe is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. This layer represents the evolution of the coast line from the national coastal erosion indicator in the form of histograms along the coastal linear. The data concern the metropolis and the five (5) overseas departments (Guadeloupe, Martinique, Guyana, Mayotte and Réunion). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Evolution of the coast line (histograms) Guadeloupe" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include trait de côte, littoral, évolution, érosion, accrétion, Régions maritimes. The listing shows 2018-06-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
